Running command: python3 -c "
import struct
parser_flags = 0
renderer_flags = 0
md_input = b'6'
poc = struct.pack('<II', parser_flags, renderer_flags) + md_input
with open('/tmp/poc_min.bin', 'wb') as f:
    f.write(poc)
print('Minimal PoC size:', len(poc))
"
cd /tmp && ./test_md /tmp/poc_min.bin 2>&1 | head -25; echo "EXIT: $?"
